SymbolicEssence.ArchetypalFunction: To embody memory, remembrance, and preservation of knowledge; mother of all arts through the Muses.
SymbolicEssence.SymbolicCore: The eternal repository of all that was, foundation of culture and art.

CulturalContext.ReligiousOrRitualUse: Invoked by poets and oral storytellers; her pool in Hades grants remembrance of past lives; essential to mystery cults.
CulturalContext.HistoricalEvolution: Pre-literate personification of oral tradition and memory; elevated through Zeus to mother all artistic inspiration.

SymbolicRepresentation.ImageryNotes: Depicted with thoughtful expression, often holding tablets or scrolls; sometimes shown with her nine daughters the Muses.
SymbolicRepresentation.PoeticInvocation: Mother of memory, keeper of all songs, from whose depths spring all the Muses.
SymbolicRepresentation.DreamForm: An infinite library where every memory ever lived still breathes on the pages

MetaIntegration.RitualFunction: Invoked before creative work, storytelling, and rituals requiring remembrance of tradition.
AIPromptSeeds: The mother who remembers every story ever told, birthing them again as art.
The pool that reflects not your face but every life you've ever lived.
NarrativeHooks: The character who remembers what everyone else forgot
The source of all artistic inspiration
The choice between memory and forgetfulness
